description: Search the UK specialty business finance lenders that FundBiz reviews (editorial research, not a lender panel). Filter by free-text query, product type, or eligibility flags. Returns factual terms (ticket range, typical rate, decision time, soft-search, Ltd-only, FCA-regulated) plus an editorial rating. Read-only.

ltd_only.description: Only lenders that lend to limited companies only.

product_type.description: Substring match on product type, e.g. "merchant cash advance", "term loan", "asset finance", "invoice finance".

query.description: Free-text match on name, summary and best-for tags.

soft_search_only.description: Only lenders that use a soft search at quote stage.

name: search_lenders
